scenarios.description: Remove origin with 10k packed tracking refs vs git remote remove

detail.setup: remote http://127.0.0.1:42219/remote.git served by git http-backend (git's own smart HTTP server)
detail.prepare:
set -eu
grit-bench prepare-daily-reset --git git
cd /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-remote-many-refs-ls/remote.git-campaign-push-client
git remote remove origin 2>/dev/null || true
git remote add origin 'http://127.0.0.1:42219/remote.git'
git fetch -q origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*'
git pack-refs '--all'
